description: Test suite for the HpackFuzzUtil functions related to HTTP/2 header compression fuzzing, including header block parsing, context initialization, and mutation testing.

classes.name: HpackFuzzUtil
classes.description: Namespace containing utilities for fuzz testing of HPACK header compression.

methods.name: InitializeGeneratorContext
methods.description: Initializes the generator context with seed data.

methods.name: NextGeneratedHeaderSet
methods.description: Generates the next set of headers based on the current context.

methods.name: NextHeaderBlock
methods.description: Parses the next header block from input data.

methods.name: HeaderBlockPrefix
methods.description: Creates a header block prefix for a given size.

methods.name: RunHeaderBlockThroughFuzzerStages
methods.description: Runs a header block through all fuzzing stages.

methods.name: FlipBits
methods.description: Mutates a buffer by flipping bits.
